command:
set -euo pipefail
ulimit -c 0
test "$(git -C /source rev-parse HEAD)" = "a0fa25492b3ec9badaa43f8cd489fbb68fe06494"
test -z "$(git -C /source status --porcelain)"
git -C /source status --short --branch
git -C /source rev-parse HEAD
cmake --version
c++ --version
glslc --version
cmake -S /source -B /build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DLLMX_HAS_BACKEND_VULKAN=ON -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON
cmake --build /build --parallel 2 --target llmx llmx-model-logits llmx-tq-test llmx-spec-test llmx-server-passes-cpu-test llmx-backend-vulkan-test
/build/llmx --version > /out/version.txt 2>&1
cat /out/version.txt
grep -F 'a0fa25492b3e' /out/version.txt
! grep -E 'dirty|unknown' /out/version.txt
ctest --test-dir /build --output-on-failure --no-tests=error --output-junit /out/ctest.xml --timeout 600 -R '^(tq-format|spec|server-passes-cpu)$'
test "$(git -C /source rev-parse HEAD)" = "a0fa25492b3ec9badaa43f8cd489fbb68fe06494"
test -z "$(git -C /source status --porcelain)"
